summary: Run a playbook locally from VS Code by right-clicking it in Explorer and choosing Run Ansible Playbook via > Run playbook via ansible-playbook; output appears in the Terminal tab and ok=2 failed=0 means success.
questions: How do I run a playbook with ansible-playbook from VS Code?
Where is the output when I run a playbook in VS Code?
How do I know my playbook ran successfully in VS Code?
